Leonora Neuffer Bilger received the Francis P. Garvan–John M. Olin Medal in 1953. The team note's claim that she was honored in the late 1940s conflicts with this, and I haven't checked it against a source. My earlier citations to Wikipedia and Prabook were also not checked in this conversation, so the 1953 date rests on my recall.

CONFIDENCE: 85
